title: dbarena benchmark result
description: One scenario's benchmark result: provider identity, reproducibility info, pricing, and a concurrency sweep with per-iteration measurements. Heavy per-second raw metrics live in separate CSV files referenced from sweep[].iterations[].raw_metrics_file, never inlined here.

schema_version.description: Version of this JSON Schema the file conforms to, e.g. "1.0.0".

provider.description: Slug for the cloud/platform provider under test, e.g. "aws", "gcp", "supabase". Also encoded in the directory path ($provider/$product/$workload/$scenario/result.json); repeated here so the file is self-contained.

product.description: Slug for the managed database product under test, e.g. "rds", "cloud-sql-for-postgres", "supabase", "orioledb". Distinguishes multiple products under the same provider (e.g. Supabase's vanilla Postgres vs. OrioleDB). Also encoded in the directory path; repeated here so the file is self-contained.

workload.description: Slug for the benchmark workload, e.g. "tpcc", "tpce". Also encoded in the directory path; repeated here so the file is self-contained.

scenario.description: Slug identifying this specific scenario, folding in bound-type + size tier + config variant (e.g. "cache-exceeding-small", "cache-fit-2xlarge-performance-optimized"). Matches the directory name this file lives in.

tier.description: Size tier label, e.g. "small", "medium", "large", "xlarge". Null for providers/scenarios with no tier concept.

bound_type.description: What the scenario is designed to bottleneck on. Known values today: "cache-fit", "cache-exceeding". Free-form string (not an enum) so future scenario types don't require a schema change.

variant.description: Distinguishes multiple configs within the same tier+bound_type (e.g. "cost-optimized" vs "performance-optimized" -- the same compute tier at two disk configurations). Null when there's only one config for this tier+bound_type.

instance.description: Hardware/deployment configuration under test. Generic across workloads; workload-specific sizing knobs go in each sweep point's workload_parameters instead.

disk_type.description: Provider-specific disk/volume type selected for this configuration, e.g. "gp3", "io2", "HYPERDISK_BALANCED", "PD_SSD". Null for providers/tiers with no disk-type concept.

cpu_arch.description: e.g. "aarch64", "x86_64". Providers on burstable/shared-tenancy tiers may not pin architecture across runs -- record what was actually observed for this run.

engine_version.description: Full version string of the database engine observed during this run, e.g. Postgres's `SELECT version()` output.

pg_settings.description: Flattened snapshot of relevant pg_settings values captured during this run as a raw comma-separated string.

orioledb_version.description: OrioleDB extension version observed during this run. Present only when the engine under test is OrioleDB.

measured_from.description: Start timestamp of the earliest iteration across the whole sweep (UTC, ISO 8601).

measured_to.description: Completion timestamp of the latest iteration across the whole sweep (UTC, ISO 8601).

reproducibility.description: Everything needed to reproduce this run. Fields may be null for historical runs that predate structured provenance capture.

benchctl_version.description: benchctl's own build version, e.g. "1.2.0+20260727-abc1234" (version+date+short git SHA, per its build ldflags).

dbarenactl_version.description: dbarenactl's own build version (dbarenactl --version), e.g. "dev+20260906-abc1234" or "1.4.0".

version.description: Git commit or tag of the load-generator dependency actually used.

command.description: The dbarenactl invocation that reproduces this exact test point, e.g. "dbarenactl run --candidate candidates/aws/rds/tpcc/manifest.yaml --test-point 2xlarge/cache-fit/performance-optimized". Not a raw benchctl command, and it omits --set overrides -- every value those would carry (warehouses, disk sizing, ...) is already reported in instance and sweep[].workload_parameters.

pricing.description: Null when the provider's terms don't allow publishing pricing. Itemized in components: monthly_usd is exactly the sum of every component's amount_usd (discounts/credits are components with a negative amount_usd).

monthly_usd.description: Total estimated monthly cost in USD for the instance configuration under test.

hours_per_month.description: Hours-per-month assumption used to annualize/monthly-ize hourly rates, e.g. 730.

pricing_model.description: e.g. "on-demand-list-price" -- publicly stated list price, no negotiated discounts or reserved-instance terms.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp when the pricing snapshot used to compute monthly_usd was fetched. Null only if pricing itself is null.

components.description: Itemized cost components that sum to monthly_usd, e.g. compute, storage, IOPS/throughput overage. A discount or credit is a component with a negative amount_usd (e.g. Supabase's Pro-plan compute credit).

name.description: Component identifier, e.g. "compute", "storage", "iops_overage", "compute_credit". Provider-specific -- not an enum, since providers decompose cost differently.

amount_usd.description: This component's contribution to monthly_usd. Negative for discounts/credits.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the rate/quantity used to compute amount_usd, e.g. the SKU, unit rate, and provisioned amount.

sweep.description: One entry per concurrency level tested (e.g. client/thread count). A non-sweeping scenario is just an array of length 1.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent clients/threads driving load at this sweep point.

peak.description: True for exactly one sweep point: the one whose median iteration has the highest NEW_ORDER tpm. Ties go to the lower concurrency.

workload_parameters.description: Workload-specific sizing/config knobs for this sweep point.

iterations.description: One entry per repeated run of this sweep point.

median.description: True for exactly one iteration per sweep point: the one with the median NEW_ORDER tpm (the lower median for an even count).

started_at.description: Start of the measured benchmark step at this concurrency.

completed_at.description: End of the measured benchmark step at this concurrency.

tpm_per_dollar_month.description: Precomputed NEW_ORDER tpm / pricing.monthly_usd. Null when pricing is null.

workload_metrics.description: Full workload-native metric breakdown for this iteration.

metadata.description: benchctl metadata records captured at this concurrency, keyed by record name.

raw_metrics_file.description: Relative path to the CSV file holding a timeseries of raw samples for this iteration.

notes.description: Free-text data-quality caveat about this specific iteration, e.g. a crashed/truncated run whose figures are reconstructed/approximated rather than a clean full-duration measurement.
